gaps.title: Fourier quadrature transfer
gaps.detail: Transforms, tail matrices, and dual PSD margins are floating quadrature objects.
gaps.next_action: Interval-enclose basis integrals and propagate matrix-entry errors to an eigenvalue margin.

gaps.title: Continuous axis supremum
gaps.detail: A step-0.25 axis grid missed peaks and produced a false alpha<1 escape at R=16.
gaps.next_action: Use adaptive maximization plus derivative or interval enclosures before treating any alpha<1 as a gate pass.

gaps.title: Full refined-cover joint exhaustion
gaps.detail: Only 12 of 288 refined patches received joint axis/core optimization.
gaps.next_action: Exhaust only after a dictionary can pass the currently blocked difficult patches; otherwise the computation has no decision value.

gaps.title: Theorem-backed count and tail objects
gaps.detail: Published S(T) constants are used, but endpoint hypotheses, directed rounding, and the tail inequality are not packaged as theorem objects.
gaps.next_action: Create interval-evaluated band counts and a theorem-backed tail matrix.

gaps.title: Arithmetic histogram error
gaps.detail: Linear log-bin deposition reduces matrix updates but has no certified interpolation error.
gaps.next_action: Bound correlation-kernel derivatives on each bin and accumulate an interval matrix error.

gaps.title: Large-support prime enumeration
gaps.detail: R=12,14,16 have only PNT-style cost projections; R=16 reaches a cutoff near 7.9e13.
gaps.next_action: Do not enumerate until dual-gated axis-notch co-design yields a viable finite candidate at an existing radius.

gaps.title: Axis-notch dictionary
gaps.detail: Support-only expansion reduces uniform thresholds but joint measures still block sampled radii.
gaps.next_action: Build RH_Axis_Notch_Cover_Codesign_v0.5 from the active supports in saved witnesses.

gaps.title: Primal candidate after dual gate
gaps.detail: No sampled radius passed the safe dual gate, so high-cost primal search was not launched.
gaps.next_action: Launch primal Gram, dense core, guard-ring, and dense-axis audits only after a safe dual non-block.

gaps.title: Unknown off-axis leakage regions
gaps.detail: The complete zero-side regional budget remains unclosed.
gaps.next_action: Partition every orbit-type region and attach a validated sign or leakage bound.

gaps.title: Zero presence and winding
gaps.detail: No argument-principle object proves a zero exists in a selected target patch.
gaps.next_action: Attach validated winding certificates only after the global budget architecture is viable.

gaps.title: Local-to-global RH closure
gaps.detail: No formally checked implication closes all quantifiers from finite patch witnesses to RH.
gaps.next_action: Build a theorem dependency graph and independently verify every analytic transfer.
